processing_steps.heating_or_cooling_rate: calculated maximum cooling rate at about 5×10^3 K/s
processing_steps.processing_steps_notes: Alloy ingot from high purity Fe (99.99%), Mn (99.9%), Al (99.9%), C (99.8%), Cr (99.9%); reheated to melt by an induction coil then poured into a copper mold at a rotating speed of 600 r/min in Ar atmosphere; strip size (60–80) mm × 60 mm × 2.5 mm. This is the parent (as-cast) step producing the 3Cr strip subsequently annealed.
Heat-treated in a vacuum electric resistance furnace at 550 °C for 5 h; this defines the annealed 3Cr strip sample.

measurement_conditions.other_conditions: Annealed condition (550 °C for 5 h); averaged over 3 measurements (each test supported by more than three tensile specimens)

strain_hardening_rate.note: Strain hardening rate increases with Cr content among annealed strips
strain_hardening_rate.value: reduction in strain hardening rate of annealed 3Cr strip is the largest, about 500 MPa (relative to as-cast 3Cr)

tensile_properties.stress_strain_curves: Engineering stress–strain and true stress/strain-hardening-rate curves of annealed 3Cr strip shown in Fig. 8 (a,b)

precipitates.type: κ-carbide (SADP superlattice still very weak; XRD κ(111) peak not observed)

phases_present.morphology: fine dots plus short elongated/angular fragments (SEM of annealed 3Cr)
phases_present.volume_fraction: 11.4 vol% (as-cast 3Cr value; ferrite size/fraction in annealed strips almost unchanged)

phases_present.morphology: nano-scale ordered domains giving angular/blocky DF contrast

microstructure_list.region: dispersed second-phase particles in austenite matrix

structures.number_of_phases: 2 main phases (austenite + ferrite), with minor κ-carbide in austenite and DO3 ordering in ferrite
structures.overall_structure: After annealing at 550 °C for 5 h the 3Cr strip is still composed of an austenite (γ) matrix plus δ-ferrite; κ-carbide precipitation remains suppressed (SADP superlattice very weak/absent), the δ-ferrite contains DO3 ordered domains, and the austenite dislocation density is reduced relative to the as-cast 3Cr strip but still higher than the annealed 0Cr strip. SEM shows a smooth grey matrix with dispersed dark second-phase particles and no resolvable grain boundary/dendritic network.
